name: asset
why: The only group that mints an asset. An asset coin in the shared float changes what every later sats-only spend can select, so nothing that measures the sats float runs beside it.

name: lifecycle
why: Reads the wallet's own float, so it needs one with no minted asset in it, and a server still charging its intent fees: vtxoLifecycle's headline assertion is the ABSENCE of INTENT_INSUFFICIENT_FEE, which a fee-free arkd makes vacuous. blockTimelocks rides along because it wants the same emulator-only stack, and asserts the block-typed exit delay it needs rather than assuming it.

name: send-lightning
why: Needs the boltz profile: the counterparty is the base `lnd`, the solver's own node is `boltz-lnd`, and setupBoltz() is the only thing that funds that node and opens the channel between them.

name: receive-lightning
why: The one group that also needs covclaimd: covclaimdClaim proves the daemon claims a lockup nobody in the test ever claims, and receiveLightningEdges has a reveal test that requires it. Separate from send-lightning because covclaimd watches arkd's tx stream and sweeps preimage-gated lockups, which the send legs do not want happening under them.

name: onchain
why: Same stack as send-lightning; split for run time and for attribution, since these five files confirm real transactions and are the slowest set here.

name: self-payment
why: Same stack as send-lightning; split for run time and for attribution.

name: evm
why: Needs two stacks at once: arkade-regtest for the Arkade leg and `scripts/e2e-stack.mjs` for anvil plus the flat price feed on :8088. priceFeed rides along because it is the only other file that reads that feed.
